GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, ridden along tur, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little, dropped out # faced breeze
Jumped Well to lead 2 Lengths clear, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, headed approaching 200m, kept on well # no match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported it was not his intention to lead, however when the race lacked early speed and the gelding commenced to race keenly in the early stages, he allowed it to stride forward where it was able to obtain the lead without being placed under undue pressure. He added the gelding was inclined to lay out through the middle stages and in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back Worse than midfield rails 7 Lengths 1000m, stayed back inside and loomed to be in finish at 200m, battled on well enough and was not beaten all that far # not far away

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn then steered two lanes short of centre of track Straightening Up , loomed early in Straight before dropping off in the inferior going. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it failed to travel strongly at any stage, was disappointing to the line and was never comfortable on the Heavy-10 going with its form suggesting it appreciates firmer going. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # didn't handle going
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider stated mount failed to travel strongly any stage of the event & was disappointing in its run to the line. Rdr stated mount was never comfortable on the Heavy 10 track conditions and its form suggests it appreciates firmer going than that today. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.
